title: When Do Hilbert-Huang and Wavelet Evidence Improve Controlled Underwater Acoustic Detection?
scope: Fully synthetic clip-presence study; no temporal or real-field detection claim
missing_view_policy: Replace one acquired view by its train-fitted feature mean, with no retraining; diagnostic distribution shift

regimes.harmonic_am: single active type-0 source: amplitude-modulated harmonics with bounded frequency variation
regimes.chirp_dominant: single active type-1 source: swept tone plus 0.3 times harmonic component
regimes.decaying_am: single active type-2 source: harmonic/AM signal with exponential event envelope; not an impulse or real vessel class
regimes.overlapping_sources: two active synthetic sources, any type

regime_negatives: Reuse all background-only scenes from the same evaluation partition in each regime; report each denominator and do not pool regimes

feature_timing.scope: GPU-resident transform extraction only, including synchronization; excludes waveform transfer, classifier and generation

hht_status: Exploratory bounded piecewise-linear EMD approximation; six modes, ten sifts; high noisy-scene nonconvergence is reported
freeze_requirement: Before evaluation, runs/test_freeze.json must contain synthetic_features_config_sha256 and artifacts SHA256 entries for this config, script, supplemental model index and every model checkpoint.
